RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 0

Both you and the successful candidate are men, making sex discrimination virtually impossible as a deciding factor. Raising the panel's gender composition would likely undermine your credibility, as an all-male panel selecting a male candidate provides no evidence of anti-male bias. 

While an all-male panel might reflect an administrative oversight regarding civil service diversity guidelines, it does not suggest unfair bias against you. The appointee brought specific international project leadership experience that the ministry valued. Instead of raising gender, follow up politely on your request for written feedback to learn how the panel scored your competencies and interview performance.
